nodes.label: HM Architect — Tangier (studio site)
nodes.rationale: Cinematic portfolio site for an architecture and interiors studio working between Tangier, Tétouan and Brussels.

nodes.label: PLACEHOLDER_SEED
nodes.rationale: Generates five more placeholder entries per category (24 total) so the slider and filters have content to lay out against; borrows real projects' imagery, rotated so no two cards open on the same plate. Flagged placeholder:true and nothing else refers to them, so removable by deleting PLACEHOLDER_SEED and the ...placeholders spread.

nodes.label: tools/process-images.sh
nodes.rationale: Processes Instagram screenshot source images offline: removes carousel chrome via ffmpeg's delogo filter (rather than cropping, to preserve full ~850px frame), applies a light grade, and outputs two sizes per plate (native NN.webp and upscaled NN-lg.webp).

nodes.label: src/js/loader.js
nodes.rationale: Shuffles a small plate through the portfolio as images decode, tracks real progress via a counter, then flies the plate to full bleed as the headline wipes up word by word.

nodes.label: src/js/hero.js
nodes.rationale: Only decides when to cut between four cross-cutting full-bleed plates; the Ken Burns drift itself lives in CSS so a class toggle restarts it.

nodes.label: src/js/mark.js
nodes.rationale: Fetches and inlines hma-mark.svg so the monogram's own contour can be lifted via <use> and stroked; draws the contour with a dash offset like a drawing-board reveal, then floods fill and retires the contour. Falls back to a fading raster if the fetch never lands.

nodes.label: hma-mark.svg (traced mark)
nodes.rationale: Traced in two passes because the artwork mixes a solid two-tone monogram with a half-pixel hairline subline at partial alpha.

nodes.label: src/js/work.js
nodes.rationale: Card-deck slider in CSS 3D perspective. Position is a float eased by a lerp loop rather than an index. layout() owns every card's transform/opacity/z-index exclusively.

nodes.label: src/css/base.css
nodes.rationale: Holds colour/type tokens: white ground with burgundy reserved for numbered labels, badges, the SEE WORK line, hover/focus states, and the menu overlay/cookie notice surfaces.

nodes.label: src/js/contact.js
nodes.rationale: Validation is real; submission is not — send() needs to be replaced with a POST to a real endpoint before going live.

nodes.label: public/favicon.svg
nodes.rationale: Same monogram on a burgundy disc, needing a ground and extra optical weight since a plain reduction's hairlines vanish at tab size.

nodes.label: npm run trace:mark
nodes.rationale: Regenerates hma-mark.svg (and the favicon) from the master PNG, tracing the monogram and subline at different thresholds.

nodes.label: hma-monogram.svg
nodes.rationale: Header runs the monogram alone rather than the full lockup because under ~120px the subline becomes an unreadable grey smear. White artwork so it works with the header's difference blend.

nodes.label: hma-original.jpg
nodes.rationale: The supplied artwork, untouched, on its burgundy plate.

nodes.label: hma-mark.png
nodes.rationale: Mark lifted off the burgundy plate by luminance keying: threshold at 88 removes the plate cleanly and RGB is forced white to avoid burgundy fringing.

nodes.label: hma-mark.webp
nodes.rationale: 7kB fallback image used if the SVG fetch never arrives.

nodes.label: haytham-mribah.jpg (founder portrait)
nodes.rationale: Fixed 4:5 box with object-fit: cover so a differently-shaped replacement needs no manual crop.

nodes.label: ICON_STROKE
nodes.rationale: Extra weight added to the favicon mark in the mark's own units — the optical sizing a type designer applies for small text.

nodes.label: src/js/raf.js
nodes.rationale: Races requestAnimationFrame against a timer so the loader doesn't stall in a suspended background tab.

nodes.label: Archivo (Google Fonts)
nodes.rationale: Variable width and weight display face.

nodes.label: Tangier Sky Ring
nodes.rationale: Square-format plate project; frame ratios come from --plate-ratio so it is not letterboxed next to wide-format projects.

nodes.label: Subline sub-pixel hinting technique
nodes.rationale: HAYTHAM MRIBAH ARCHITECTS is drawn one source pixel wide; .mark__sub answers it like hinting a sub-pixel stem: 0.7px vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke holds every stroke at a full pixel regardless of scale.

nodes.label: Capability Section (#capability)
nodes.rationale: Five capability rows (Architecture, Health & public, Interior architecture, Mixed-use & retail, Delivery on site) as the studio's quiet, type-only 'drawing register'.

nodes.label: Contact Form (#contactForm)
nodes.rationale: Front-end demo — submissions are logged to the console rather than sent.

nodes.label: Aerial Night Rendering of Hôpital Provincial de Tétouan
nodes.rationale: Bird's-eye nighttime visualization: comb/cross-shaped multi-wing hospital with internal courtyards, textured masonry cladding, ground-level uplighting, dark technical roof, landscaped site with roundabout, parking, reflecting pools at the main entrance.

nodes.label: Hôpital Provincial de Tétouan - Main Entrance at Dusk
nodes.rationale: Twilight photo of the main entrance: cantilevered timber-lattice pergola canopy over the drop-off, vertical wood-slat facade screening, bilingual entrance signage, ambulance and pedestrians on a wet paved forecourt.

nodes.label: Démarche Conceptuelle — Massing Diagram Sequence
nodes.rationale: Five sequential axonometric diagrams showing the design process: initial mass -> patios for daylighting -> medical-technical/logistics platform -> hospitalization ward sector -> final composite volume. Labeled 'DÉMARCHE CONCEPTUELLE'.

nodes.label: Résidence Terracotta - Master Bedroom & Ensuite Bathroom Suite
nodes.rationale: Terracotta-lacquered paneling, sage-green upholstery, brass accents, herringbone flooring transitioning to veined marble bathroom with freestanding tub and walk-in shower.

nodes.label: Résidence Terracotta – Living Room with Terracotta Media Wall
nodes.rationale: Built-in terracotta-lined media/fireplace wall, olive sectional sofa, marble hearth, herringbone flooring, brass pendant light.

nodes.label: Résidence Terracotta – Kitchen Island Interior (Plate 03)
nodes.rationale: Marble waterfall-edge island, terracotta/cream cabinetry, copper accents, brass pendants, olive velvet bar stools.

nodes.label: Smile Lab Brussels – Staff Meeting Room
nodes.rationale: Clinic meeting room: staff in lab coats at wooden conference table, floor-to-ceiling glazing onto courtyard garden, oak paneling with cove LED lighting.

nodes.label: Full-Height Oak Wood Paneling with Integrated LED Cove Lighting
nodes.rationale: Rear wall/ceiling oak paneling with built-in screen and cove LED lighting.

nodes.label: Floor-to-Ceiling Glazing Overlooking Landscaped Courtyard
nodes.rationale: Timber-framed glass wall connecting interior to a planted exterior courtyard.

nodes.label: Polished Concrete Flooring
nodes.rationale: Grey polished concrete floor, industrial-minimalist counterpoint to warm millwork.

nodes.label: Solid Wood Conference/Consultation Table with Upholstered Task Chairs
nodes.rationale: Large light-wood table with cream upholstered rolling chairs.

nodes.label: Clinical Staff in White Lab Coats Reviewing Documents
nodes.rationale: Three staff in medical lab coats discussing documents at the table.

nodes.label: Slim Linear Pendant Light Fixtures Over Table
nodes.rationale: Two cylindrical pendant lamps over the table.

nodes.label: Smile Lab Brussels - Director's Office with Courtyard View
nodes.rationale: Oak L-shaped desk, wood veneer cabinetry with LED lighting, polished concrete floor, glazed corner opening onto brick courtyard, separate seating nook.

nodes.label: Smile Lab Brussels - Treatment Room with Garden-View Corridor
nodes.rationale: Dental treatment bay in a glazed corridor overlooking a bamboo courtyard and living green wall; travertine reception counter.

nodes.label: Smile Lab Brussels – Treatment Room with Living Green Wall
nodes.rationale: Dental operatory with white chair, wood-slat wainscoting, backlit living plant wall, dome pendant lights.

nodes.label: Smile Lab Brussels – Reception Desk and Waiting Lounge
nodes.rationale: Oak reception counter with backlit 'smile lab brussels DENTAL CLINIC' logotype, bouclé lounge seating, street-facing windows with roman blinds.

nodes.label: Staff Lounge and Kitchenette with Pool Table (Smile Lab Brussels)
nodes.rationale: Oak kitchenette, convertible pool/dining table, beige sectional lounge, sliding glass wall to terrace garden.

nodes.label: Oak Kitchenette Millwork with Espresso Machine
